question: Does continued native fitting with preserved Adam/EMA/RNG, unchanged model and same frozen reference targets improve conditional Entry/Exit values and decisions beyond the completed256 checkpoint?
measurement: Reuse the same TRAIN256 Entry/Exit anchors and1024 sampled Exit states, all nine months. Compare saved initial, ONLINE256, ONLINE512 and fixed TRAIN constants. No new initial measurement because ONLINE function is unchanged.
decision: Improved conditional values on both sides and better Entry and Exit decisions are required for the learning gate. A lower total loss or more trades alone is insufficient. A weak result ends this fixed test; no automatic extension or checkpoint search.
preserve: Continue the exact next256 native batches of the existing47814-row chronological TRAIN prefix. Keep model, loss, features, all source data/normalization, reference policy, frozen teacher, optimizer moments, EMA, scheduler, RNG and order. Original256 state and all earlier artifacts remain read-only. New output directory only.
scope_note: This is one separately specified bounded TRAIN convergence experiment based on measured conditional underfit and descending joint direction. It is not a full epoch, chronological evaluation, economics run or declaration that extra steps will help.
